title: 第23章 大势已去第24章 玄阴月之华
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
‘忭哒’，‘轰隆隆’
厚厚的乌云黑压压的在天空流动，
如银蛇一般的闪电直通大地后，
闷雷在滚动，
大地都在微微颤抖。
‘呜·呃·呃呃·’，‘咚·咚·咚咚·’
彝凉边疆缓坡地带，
对阵双方的战鼓号角吹的正急，
西蜀王国的十万大军统一的深黄色战袍黑色盔甲，
机弩，箭车，喷火车在军阵前压，
手中的钨铁佩剑，战刀寒光闪闪，
他们眼中彤彤有神，
气势压人，
成半月阵以排山倒海之势向前推进，
手中的兵器撞击地面或者盾牌，
‘笃笃笃’的极具压迫感，
加上整齐‘杀杀杀’的呐喊，
真的是杀声震天，声势压人。
···
商氏王朝，

本就因为王公贵族荒淫无道，
没有凝聚力，国力处于弱势，
在数场对战后，
如今这些到处抓来的壮丁，衣衫不整，黄皮寡瘦，走在一字阵前，
后面的正规军各路头领在大声吆喝；
‘为大商王朝尽忠的时候到了，冲吧，战胜敌军今晚重重有赏，美酒敞开喝，美人任你挑’
‘呸’
行进中的元罗狠狠地啐了一口碎沫子，看着黑压压的对面；
‘狗咋种，骗鬼，狗眼都可以看出大势已去，绝对实力面前，精神粮食还有用吗’
‘阵前动乱军心，找死’
后面的马兵一枪就刺向元罗后背心，
云阳刚刚准备抓住黑枪为元罗求情的一刹那，
‘咻咻咻’，‘嗖嗖嗖’
双方的弓箭手和箭车已经开始铺天盖地的对射，
马兵赶紧收回黑枪回挑飞箭。
content_en:
‘Boom’, ‘Boom’
Thick dark clouds flowed darkly in the sky,
After lightning like a silver snake penetrated the earth,
The thunder is rolling,
The earth was trembling slightly.
‘Woo·uh·uh uh·’, ‘dong·dong·dong dong·’
The gentle slopes of the Yiliang border area,
The war drums and horns of both sides are blowing urgently,
The 100,000-strong army of the Western Shu Kingdom uniformly wore dark yellow uniforms and black armor.
Crossbows, arrow carts, and spray trains pressed in front of the military formation,
The tungsten iron sword in his hand is shining with cold light,
There is something bright in their eyes,
The momentum is overwhelming,
The half-moon formation advanced with overwhelming momentum.
The weapon in his hand hits the ground or shield,
‘Tuk-tuk-tuk’ is extremely oppressive.
Coupled with the neat shouts of ‘kill kill kill’,
The killing sound was really loud and overwhelming.
···
Shang Dynasty,
It was because of the debauchery and immorality of the princes and nobles,
Without cohesion, national strength is weak.
After several battles,
Nowadays, these strong men captured from everywhere, with disheveled clothes and yellow skin, are walking in front of a formation.
The leaders of the regular army behind were shouting loudly;
"The time has come to be loyal to the Great Shang Dynasty. Go ahead. Defeat the enemy and you will be rewarded tonight. Open the wine to drink, and you can choose the beauties."
‘Bah’
Yuan Luo, who was marching, spit out the foam and looked at the dark opposite side;
‘How can a dog breed? He is a liar. Even a dog’s eyes can tell that the situation is over. In the face of absolute strength, is spiritual food still useful?’
‘To unsettle the morale of the army before the battle and seek death’
The cavalry soldier behind stabbed Yuan Luo's back vest with one shot.
The moment Yunyang was about to seize the black gun to plead for Yuan Luo,
‘Whoosh whoosh whoosh’, ‘whoosh whoosh whoosh’
Archers and arrow chariots from both sides have begun to shoot at each other overwhelmingly.
The cavalryman quickly retracted his black spear and picked up the flying arrow.
